title: BitClub Network Compensation Plan 1 of 81
description: The 4 Investment options of Bitclub Network.

asr.full_text: Hi there and welcome! This is Edzart. This is the first of eight videos discussing the Bit-Luck Network Compensation Plan. You can also find a copy on the Compensation Plan in the online website under Resources Compensation Plan. So, of course, how do you earn commissions? You would join for $99 payable in Bitcoin Cash and then buy a share in a mining pool starting at $500 if you do not buy the share in the mining pool at $500 and you were to recruit or tell other people about that club and they start mining of course they will earn their mining earnings but your Commission's will get held the back until you mine or until your Commission's add up to enough so that you have or get automatically a share in a mining pool so there's four types of Bitcoin mining pools and bitlab the first is a 500 second is a thousand or pool three added $2,000 if you do all of them together this is known as a founders pool the initial mining pool contracts valid for a thousand days if you decide to compound it part your buy with your earnings you will not stop mining so let's quickly discuss this of course you start let's say you buy your mining pool share it's valid for a thousand days so as we can see your let's say $5 mining share will mine for a thousand days what it will do is depending on your settings you can adjust it to have all your mining earnings your Bitcoin in this case that you've mined go back to buy partial shares now your mining as in this example for not $500 but $525 and this will then obviously go faster and faster and faster so before your initial thousand-day mining contract expires in your first share it is possible that you would have doubled your shares so a quick and easy way basically to let your mining continue basically forever Now important to understand, as Einstein said compound interest is the 8th one in the world he understands it and that neither doesn't pays it there's also two GPU mining pools in bitlab network these mine at teriem adherent classic see casual Monero this a thousand dollar option and a five thousand dollar option on these you earn a hundred percent you actually do not have the option to do

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents a participation offer requiring a $99 Bitcoin Cash payment and a mining-pool share purchase starting at $500. It describes recruitment-linked commissions, tiered purchases, percentage-based commission or repurchase terms, possible share doubling, compounding, and a GPU-pool “Earn 100%” claim, although actual payments, mining performance, or delivered returns are not established.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video's central offer is purchasing paid mining-pool shares and receiving mining earnings over a stated duration, with compounding described as a way to increase shares. This directly supports paid mining or node returns. Recruitment commissions are mentioned, but the supplied evidence does not establish a multi-person downline, team hierarchy, matrix, or tier qualification tied to income.
